title: BeatScript embed config
description: One config for every way BeatScript is embedded: the <beatscript-track> player, the <beatscript-studio> editor, a static card and plain audio, on a Claude artifact, any web page, an iframe, oEmbed, a README, a notebook, an editor's preview or the Android app. Every surface reads it: as JSON (the `config` attribute or a child <script type="application/json" class="beatscript-config">), as single attributes (which override it), or as the btwserve `embed` MCP tool's `config` argument. A surface that cannot do something the config asks for says so and does what it can (docs/btw/embed.md).

$schema.description: This schema's URL, if the author wants an editor to check the config.

kind.description: player: a card with a Play button (<beatscript-track>). studio: the editor, its checker and the player in one element (<beatscript-studio>); the deterministic tools run in the page. card: a static card (name, CID, rights, links), no script and no sound. audio: a plain <audio> of the server's render.

source.description: What plays. Exactly one of text, cid, set or station; cid may go with text, as the CID the text must have (a text that is not that program is refused).

cid.description: A program's CID: with text, the CID it must have; alone, a program stored on the site (a page that may fetch nothing from the site needs the text too).

set.description: A set or playlist, played in order.

station.description: A radio station's name: position n always gives the same track (/radio).

n.description: With station: the position to start at.

count.description: With station: how many tracks to queue.

audio.description: How it sounds. live: the wasm engine plays as it goes (the default for player and studio). render: the engine renders one whole pass in the page first, then plays it with a seek bar. inline: the site's Ogg Opus render carried in the page as a data: URI (no script, no engine; a stored program only; the default for audio). url: the site's render by URL (<audio src>, an RSS enclosure; the host fetches it from the site).

features.description: What the surface shows. highlight: the program, highlighted, with Copy. editor: the text is editable and re-checked as it is typed (studio). mixer: deck levels and mutes. knobs: the program's control-deck knobs as sliders. download: save the .btw text and a WAV. share: the self-sealing link and the CID. compose: ask a model for a program or a change (needs the sample capability). Defaults by kind: player [share], studio [highlight, editor, share, download, compose], card [share], audio [download].

capabilities.description: Host capabilities to use when the host allows them (a Claude artifact's claude.use()); anything else works without them. sample: compose and repair ask Claude. mcp: store, share, render and queue through the viewer's BeatScript connector. db: a library of programs and playlists. downloads: save WAV and .btw. room: a live jam with everyone who has the page open. dictation: speak a compose prompt. tts: read the problems aloud. Defaults by kind: player [downloads], studio [sample, mcp, db, downloads], card and audio [].

compact.description: The small form: an 80-pixel player, a studio without the side panel.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels, where the host needs one (an iframe, oEmbed).

height.description: Height in CSS pixels, where the host needs one.

title.description: The name shown and the page's title (default the program's `#! name:`).

site.description: Where plain links point and what the server-backed forms (iframe, card, audio) are served from.

bridge.description: studio: answer MCP-shaped JSON-RPC (tools/list, tools/call) from the parent frame over postMessage.

pin.description: For generators that emit script tags: the exact package version to load and whether to give each tag its Subresource Integrity hash (from the lock file the generator keeps).
